novelty_basis: Published theorem (Grabner, Petho, Tichy, Woeginger, "Associativity of recurrence multiplication", Appl. Math. Lett. 7 (1994) 85-90). We have not re-verified their proof; our data confirm it for 31 Pisot sequences (one, with |beta| ~ 0.94, not yet associative at s <= 20).
statement:
For base sequences satisfying the dominant-root conditions of Grabner-Petho-Tichy-Woeginger (1994), the
circle product is associative once the shift parameter is large enough.
title: Pisot base sequences give associative circle products for all sufficiently large shifts
